boundary.zh: MongoDB Atlas Administration API v2；不包含 MongoDB wire protocol、Atlas Data API 或其他独立产品。
boundary.en: MongoDB Atlas Administration API v2 only; it excludes the MongoDB wire protocol, Atlas Data API, and other separately defined products.

contractSource.license: Apache-2.0 (the repository license applies to the source file; OAS info.license describes the exposed API)

blockers.zh: 管理面包含删除集群、网络与访问配置等高影响写接口，需完成 Endpoint 级 preview/confirmation 与代理禁用策略。
blockers.en: The administration surface contains high-impact mutations for clusters, networking, and access configuration; endpoint-level preview/confirmation and proxy-disable policy are still required.

blockers.zh: 需从固定 OAS 构建、测试并发布 @pontx/mongodb-atlas-admin 与 pontx-mongodb-atlas-admin；高影响 mutation 必须保留 preview-first、精确请求确认和代理安全边界。
blockers.en: Build, test, and publish @pontx/mongodb-atlas-admin and pontx-mongodb-atlas-admin from the pinned OAS; high-impact mutations must retain preview-first, exact-request confirmation, and proxy safety boundaries.

nextAction.zh: 基于已固定的官方 v2 规范提交完成双语 prose、敏感 Endpoint 的执行策略与 SDK/CLI 发布链路；仅使用仓库许可下的规范源码和独立编写的文案，不复制 MongoDB 网站文档或暗示官方背书。
nextAction.en: Use the pinned official v2 specification revision to complete bilingual prose, sensitive-endpoint execution policy, and the SDK/CLI release chain; use only repository-licensed specification source and independently authored copy, without reproducing MongoDB website documentation or implying endorsement.
